name: session-meter
description: Records compactions, per-request cache use, subagent spawns, advisor calls and rate limits to a JSONL file per session, and shows context (relative to the autocompact threshold) and rate limits above the prompt, or in a file for your statusLine script with display=statusline.

display.title: Where to show the band
display.description: band draws two lines above the prompt. statusline draws nothing there and writes the same lines to ~/.claude/mod-metrics/<session-id>.status for your statusLine script to print.
